description:
Recent X/Twitter posts about a crypto asset or topic: post text, id and time, at most 10 posts, plus how many posts the search matched. Use it when the user wants to see what is actually being said, or wants raw posts rather than an aggregated sentiment score.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

topic.description: Asset symbol, project name or free-form topic.

name: get_social_mentions
